description: PRELIMINARY correction for simulated tau object, as recommended by the TauPOG for UL2018; tau identification efficiency and fake rate scale factors (DeepTau2017v2p1VSe, DeepTau2017v2p1VSjet, DeepTau2017v2p1VSmu), tau energy scale, and tau trigger scale factors. For more info, please visit https://twiki.cern.ch/twiki/bin/viewauth/CMS/TauIDRecommendationForRun2 (This file was created on 03/09/2021)

corrections.name: DeepTau2017v2p1VSe
corrections.description: e -> tau_h fake rate SFs for DeepTau2017v2p1VSe

inputs.name: genmatch
inputs.description: genmatch: 0 or 6 = unmatched or jet, 1 or 3 = electron, 2 or 4 = muon, 5 = real tau

corrections.name: DeepTau2017v2p1VSmu
corrections.description: mu -> tau_h fake rate SFs for DeepTau2017v2p1VSmu (2018ReReco placeholder)

inputs.name: genmatch
inputs.description: genmatch: 0 or 6 = unmatched or jet, 1 or 3 = electron, 2 or 4 = muon, 5 = real tau

corrections.name: DeepTau2017v2p1VSjet
corrections.description: DeepTau2017v2p1VSjet SFs: By default, use the pT-dependent SFs with the 'pt' flag. For analyses with the ditau triggers with offline pT > 40 GeV, use the DM-dependent SFs with flag 'dm'.

inputs.name: genmatch
inputs.description: genmatch: 0 or 6 = unmatched or jet, 1 or 3 = electron, 2 or 4 = muon, 5 = real tau

inputs.name: flag
inputs.description: Flag: 'pt' = pT-dependent SFs, 'dm' = DM-dependent SFs (pT > 40 GeV)

corrections.name: tau_energy_scale
corrections.description: DM-dependent tau energy scale in UL2018, to be applied to reconstructed tau_h Lorentz vector (pT, mass and energy) in simulated data

inputs.name: genmatch
inputs.description: genmatch: 0 or 6 = unmatched or jet, 1 or 3 = electron, 2 or 4 = muon, 5 = real tau

corrections.name: tau_trigger
corrections.description: Tau Trigger SFs and efficiencies for {0} ditau, etau, mutau or ditauvbf triggers. Ditauvbf trigger SF is only available for 2017 and 2018. To get the usual DM-specific SF's, specify the DM, otherwise set DM to -1 to get the inclusive SFs. Default corrections are set to SF's, if you require the input efficiencies, you can specify so in the corrtype input variable
